newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Firstar Q1 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Firstar Q1 EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Wednesday it cut its first quarter earnings forecast for Firstar Corp to $0.49 a share from $0.52 and cut its full 1997 forecast to $2.24 a share from $2.27.
-- The move was due to some increased costs and lighter fee income in the quarter, Gruntal said in a research note.

-- "While there could be some softness in (Firstar's) results in the first half of 1997, nonetheless, we are content with (Firstar's) outlook goiong forward and maintain our outperform (long term) rating on the shares," Gruntal said.
-- Shares of Firstar, a Milwaukee-based bank holding company, were down 1/8 at 30 Wednesday. Gruntal said its price target is 35.
